module: Data module for genericGauges: computes a red/yellow tachometer zone that depends on the oil temperature (cold engine = reduced max RPM) and a shift light. The values are converted to an integer output scale (e.g. number of segments of an LED bar).
notes: Module jbeam keys (default): minOutput (0), maxOutput (20), minOutputRPM (0), maxOutputRPM (10000), minOilTemp (50, °C), maxOilTemp (90), yellowOutputOffset (-2), coldOilRPMCoef (0.5).

Adjusted red RPM = maxrpm * linear interpolation of the coefficient between coldOilRPMCoef (cold oil) and 1 (hot oil). shiftLight is true from 95% of this RPM, except in the last gear (gearIndex >= maxGearIndex).

init.desc: Reads the jbeam parameters of the output scale and the oil temperature.

updateGFX.desc: Does nothing (the update is done by updateGaugeData).

setupGaugeData.desc: Called by genericGauges with the properties requested in displayData.customModules: no property is read; always produces yellow, red (integers) and shiftLight (boolean).

properties.desc: Set of requested properties (key = name, value = true).

updateGaugeData.desc: Called by genericGauges before each send: fills moduleData with the requested values.

moduleData.desc: Module data table, then sent to the HTML page.

dt.desc: Time elapsed since the last send (s).
